name: video-workflow
description: Turn one sentence or a locked script into a synchronized, verified MP4 with a completely free local production path.

interface.shortDescription: One sentence to a free, verified video
interface.longDescription: Tell Codex what video to make in one sentence. Codex infers the content type, format, theme, scenes, and script, then the plugin uses free system narration, built-in visuals, synchronized captions and animation, loudness normalization, deterministic rendering, and quality gates to deliver a final MP4 without paid media APIs, HyperFrames, or Remotion.
defaultPrompt: Make a vertical explainer video about MCP.
Make a six-item list video about useful Codex Skills.
Check this video project for caption, audio, and timing drift.
